name: Cameron House on Loch Lomond
positioning: Lochside resort with a baronial mansion, golf, spa and lodges on the shores of Loch Lomond, within Loch Lomond & The Trossachs National Park
best_for: Golfers who want a championship course beside the loch
Families and groups wanting self-catering lodges on a lochside estate
Travelers who want time on the water and outdoor activities

facts.text: Cameron House is set on the shores of Loch Lomond, within Loch Lomond & The Trossachs National Park.
Bedrooms come in a contemporary or classic atmosphere, with estate or loch views.
Auld House suites differ from the other rooms by their increased space and additional amenities like terraces or balconies.
Suite amenities include a complimentary bar, a Nespresso coffee machine and nightly turndown.
The 9-hole Wee Demon course is an option for beginners or those looking to fine tune their swing.
Hotel residents get complimentary access to the Health Club throughout their stay.
The estate has its own marina.
Experiences include speedboat and water experiences.
Family activities include bike hire, paddle boarding, horse riding, a swimming pool and a cinema.
Restaurants include Cameron Grill and La Vista, which serves seafood.
Cameron House is 30 minutes from the city centre of Glasgow.

highlights.text: The Auld House is a baronial mansion adorned with towers and turrets, home to individually styled suites and rooms, each named after one of Loch Lomond's islands.
The resort's own boat, the Celtic Warrior, offers cruises on the loch that take in some of the loch's islands, including Inchmurrin.
The Carrick is the resort's 18-hole championship course, with elevation changes that create views, particularly from the 10th and 14th holes.
Cameron Spa has an indoor pool and a rooftop infinity pool.
Lodges, cottages and Mansion House Apartments across the grounds offer self-catering stays for up to eight guests.

considerations.text: Cameron Spa access is available for an additional cost, and the spa is located 3 miles from the main hotel building.
The self-catering lodges, cottages and apartments are not specifically adapted for accessibility.
The hotel is dog friendly, but dogs are not permitted in the apartments, cottages or lodges, except support animals.
